data.name: Biju
data.gender_notes: Biju is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Biju is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bij', meaning seed or origin. In Hindu mythology, Biju is considered a powerful and blessed name for a boy. It symbolizes the potential for growth and success, much like a seed that is planted and nurtured. The name Biju carries the meaning “Powerful, Blessed” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biju usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Biju belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Biju total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
